title: Youth Pulse 2026: purpose, trust, AI, climate, and participation
discussion_signal: The same Youth Pulse discussion links young people’s willingness to embrace AI and climate action with community-building and declining trust in institutions. It supports a collective-action reading in which purpose and participation are shaped by whether systems create credible routes to influence.
linked_research_question: What makes young people see AI, climate action, and community participation as meaningful collective projects rather than private burdens?
limits: Individual interpretation of a WEF report
The post does not provide respondent-level evidence for the specific claims
LinkedIn engagement is not representative of global youth
